name: Kintsugi
description:
Kintsugi is an AI-powered platform that automates sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for SaaS and ecommerce businesses, and financial firms. The Kintsugi MCP server lets you track your compliance without leaving the conversation.

With the Kintsugi MCP server, you can:

See your nexus exposure in real time, for free, across every jurisdiction where you sell

Look up registrations and jurisdiction-specific requirements

Estimate sales tax, VAT, and GST for a transaction, address, or product

Check on the status of your filings, for all jurisdictions

Look up customer records, transactions, and exemption certificates

Look up your product catalog and product tax categories

This MCP server informs your decisions rather than acting on your behalf: it doesn't file a return, register you in a new jurisdiction, or change any settings. 

Built for finance, accounting, and operations teams who need fast, accurate answers about their compliance status, whether that's confirming a nexus threshold, checking a customer's exemption history, or estimating tax on a new deal.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kintsugi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kintsugi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.trykintsugi.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kintsugi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kintsugi lists 46 MCP tools, including platform_get_address_needs_attention_summary_v1_addresses_needs, platform_get_address_summary_v1_addresses_summary_get, platform_get_collected_transactions_for_nexus_v1_nexus, platform_get_connection_collecting_summary_v1_connections_collec, platform_get_connections_v1_connections_get, platform_get_dashboard_charts_v1_dashboard_charts, platform_get_dashboard_stats_v1_dashboard_stats_get, platform_get_dashboard_tasks_v1_dashboard_tasks_get, platform_get_filing_by_id_v1_filings, platform_get_filing_metrics_v1_metrics_filings_get, platform_get_filings_by_registration_id_v1_filings_registration, and platform_get_filings_v1_filings_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kintsugi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kintsugi in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Kintsugi requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kintsugi is developed by Kintsugi AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
